title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Multisectoral Emergency Response & Resilience Building of IDP and Host Communities in rural Damascus is implemented by Trócaire and aims to contribute to Outcome 3.1: Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. The activities and objective include, provision of group and individual PSS session for women, and older adolescent girls and establish and/or strengthen referral mechanisms for women and older adolescent girls so, women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors use specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Programmes are in partnership with, Caritas Syria and Congrégation des Soeurs des Saints Coeurs de Jésus et de Marie (SSCC). ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Women’s protection and access to specialised GBVsupports- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
